data.long_meaning: A name of Persian origin that symbolizes the beauty and preciousness of being in the divine presence, reminding us of the infinite blessings and wonders of Allah's Paradise. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Pareechehra usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
